'''Veszprem Universalism''' is the state-promoted religious tradition of the [[Federated Syndicates of Veszprem]]. The extracted source describes it as a major force in Veszpremi society, emphasizing unity, discipline, and loyalty to the state.

This draft is a minimal bridge page. The source confirms its public role but does not yet define its theology, founding period, organization, or relationship to pre-Orderist Veszpremi religion.

== Public Role ==

By 1994, Veszprem Universalism reinforced the values of [[Unified Orderism]]. Schools, ceremonies, public culture, and civic life used religious language to support discipline, national endurance, and obedience to collective duty.

The tradition appears to function as a social partner to the Veszpremi state rather than as an independent counterweight to it. That relationship needs more canon detail before a fuller article is written.
